note: Stable source clause labels. A clause is an exact anchor sentence in one document version; a chunk covers the clause when its spans contain the whole anchor. Labels do not depend on chunking.

BAG2-1-SCOPE.anchor: The policy applies to all baggage handlers, baggage duty supervisors, and ramp leads.

BAG2-3-INSPECT.anchor: Handlers must inspect baggage for any signs of damage or tampering before loading.

BAG2-4-ESCALATE.anchor: the handler must escalate the incident to the Baggage Duty Supervisor within 10 minutes of discovery and must report it under AP-INC-002.

BAG1-4-ESCALATE.anchor: the handler must escalate the incident to the Baggage Duty Supervisor within 30 minutes of discovery and must report it under AP-INC-002.

BAG2-5-RESTRICTED.anchor: If a restricted item is found in a bag during baggage handling, the bag must not be handled further until it is approved or removed under the restricted-items approval procedure in AP-SEC-003.

INC-2-CATEGORIES.anchor: Operational incidents are categorized into four types: baggage, restricted-item, ramp safety, and equipment.

INC-3-REPORT.anchor: All operational incidents must be reported by the affected staff member to their supervisor or the Airside Duty Manager.

INC-3-BAGREF.anchor: For baggage incidents, the Reporting Staff Member must refer to AP-BAG-001 section 4 for escalation procedures.

INC-4-RECORD.anchor: The Incident Coordinator must open an incident record for every reported incident before the end of the shift in which it was reported.

INC-5-LEAD.anchor: The review meeting is led by the Incident Coordinator and includes representatives from all relevant departments.

SEC-2-MAKEUP.anchor: The baggage make-up area is restricted to authorized personnel only.

SEC-4-APPROVAL.anchor: Approval to carry a restricted item airside must be granted in writing by the Security Duty Manager before the item passes the staff screening point.

SEC-4-ENDORSE.anchor: The Line Manager must endorse the request to confirm its necessity and compliance with safety standards.

SEC-5-REPORT.anchor: The incident must be reported under AP-INC-002, including details of the item, the baggage, and the location of discovery.

SEC-6-RETENTION.anchor: All records related to restricted items, including approval requests, incident reports, and handling procedures, must be maintained for a minimum of two years.

SKY-4-ECONOMY-WEIGHT.anchor: Weight Limit: Up to 23 kg (50 lbs).

SKY-5-CARGO.anchor: No single piece over 32 kg (70 lbs) or exceeding 203 cm (80 in) in total dimensions will be accepted as checked baggage and must be shipped as cargo.

SKY-7-DG-REFERENCE.anchor: Note: For a detailed list, refer to the SkyWings Airlines Dangerous Goods Policy.

SKY-12-MOBILITY-FREE.anchor: Mobility aids (wheelchairs, walkers) transported free of charge.

SKY-12-NOTICE.anchor: Must notify the airline at least 48 hours in advance.

AE-2.1-MINIMUM.anchor: A minimum of 75 flight hours per month is guaranteed for all active pilots.

AE-2.1-RATE-UNSTATED.anchor: The base hourly rate reflects qualifications, operational responsibility, and market benchmarks.

AE-3-PER-DIEM.anchor: The domestic per diem rate is set at $3.25 per hour and international assignments are compensated at $5.00 per hour.

GAEA-1.3-DEADLINE.anchor: Submitted annually by March 31st for the preceding calendar year.

GAEA-2.2-NOX.anchor: ≤ 15 grams NOx per kilonewton of rated thrust during the Landing and Takeoff (LTO) cycle.
